answer_1.quote: Our analyses focus on two aspects: cultural adaptation in text-infilling ( §3.2) and cross-cultural performance on extractive QA and NER ( §3.3).
answer_1.outputs: Generated entities or filled tokens for text-infilling and extractive QA tasks

answer_2.quote: We compute the CBS for an Arab entity a_i as the percentage of a LM's preference for Western entities... For extractive QA, we measure accuracy... and for NER, we use F1 score.
